title: CAMERA 30 PERCENT CLOSER
why: His art survey a36 C pick: camera 30 percent closer. The default dial is 1.3 in the shared camera; saved personal zoom values stay as chosen.
now: The default camera is 30 percent closer. Reset zoom returns to 130 percent.

edits.replacement: loadZoom();   // v28.xx (cw-cx-camera130): use 1.3 only when there is no saved zoom; seed the eased camera and the dial together.

edits.anchor: if(code==='Numpad0'){ setZoom(1);   /* v28.xx (cw-gunkeys0): the 0 key is the Rocket Launcher now, so zoom to 100 is the numpad 0 only */ if(G&&!G.over) say('ZOOM 100%','sys'); }   // v22.xx (R55): a system label in caps
edits.replacement: if(code==='Numpad0'){ setZoom(ZDEFAULT); if(G&&!G.over) say('ZOOM '+Math.round(ZDEFAULT*100)+'%','sys'); }   // v28.xx (cw-cx-camera130): reset zoom uses the new default, 130 percent; number-row 0 stays the rocket launcher.
